Marek Cormer is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]].

== Activities ==
He was a member of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army. Along with [[Flann Barstere]] and [[Jon Gaelin]], he is one of three soldiers that waves to [[Faile]] after the dicomfort about Perrin and [[Berelain]] passed.{{ref/book|13|34}}

== Trivia ==
* Marek Cormer is named for Mark Comer, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
